# 16-bit Sub-channel Burst Framing — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for 16-bit Sub-channel Burst Framing. Run status: COMPLETED.

## Facts and statements

- [statement] GDDR7 divides each 32-bit channel into two independent 16-bit sub-channels, reducing burst payload size to 32 bytes (BL16) or 64 bytes (BL32) per transaction. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: 16-bit Sub-channel Burst Framing · also: https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/blackwell-memory-architecture
- [statement] The 32-byte minimum burst length directly matches L2 cacheline fill requirements for fine-grained tensor activations without fetching unneeded contiguous memory bytes. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: 16-bit Sub-channel Burst Framing · also: https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/blackwell-memory-architecture
